title: Require Recipe Stage Authoring File Shape
forbids: recipe stage index modules without exactly one canonical default createStage authority, with additional runtime exports, with deep operation-member access, or with non-sibling public configuration imports
why: A recipe stage index.ts owns one public runtime stage identity, its immediate authoring configuration, and step selection. It consumes operation contracts through public domain roots without reconstructing operation internals. Exact constructor and sibling-config authority prevent shadow stages and inherited family configuration while erased type/interface exports remain available.
remediate: Default-export exactly one createStage value with id and steps, import public configuration only from sibling ./public.config.js, consume operation contracts through public domain roots, keep helpers local, and remove every additional runtime export or re-export.
message: Recipe stage index.ts must expose only its canonical default createStage runtime authority.
